_about: The I-360 (Special Immigrant Juvenile) petition's cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing, as on its I-485 letter (schemas/cover_letter.json); the subject, enclosures and fee note are the petition's. No priority-date paragraph. An I-360 filed alone doesn't need a current priority date. The mailing address follows the client's state (schemas/uscis_lockboxes.json). The attorney approves this file before volume use. Fees per Form G-1055 (10/01/26): no filing fee for an SIJ I-360, but the Pub. L. 119-21 fee ($250) is due by separate payment.

fees: There is no USCIS filing fee for Form I-360 filed by a petitioner seeking classification as a Special Immigrant Juvenile. As required by Public Law 119-21, the additional fee of {i360_sij_pl} is enclosed as a separate payment ({schedule}).

checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.

Enclose the Public Law 119-21 fee for an SIJ I-360 as its own payment by the enclosed Form G-1450 (a U.S. card) or a Form G-1650 (a U.S. bank account), never a check: the amount the cover letter states; it can't be waived.
